meta.description: Stratified training split for supported SERO benchmarks
meta.ordering: round-robin difficulty interleave — [E0,M0,H0,V0,E1,...] for batch-diverse REINFORCE training (batch_size=8 covers 2 full difficulty waves)
meta.training_quality_filter: NaturalPlan excludes unsolvable/non_unique/wrong_answer samples from scripts/check_training_data_quality.py; Olympiad excludes text-only tasks whose stored gold answer fails a scorer round-trip via eval_fn.

tier_strategies.trip_planning: quartile on composite (cities 3-10 uniform, clean separation by city count)
tier_strategies.meeting_planning: train excludes people {1,2}; training tiers use {3-4}=easy {5-6}=medium {7-8}=hard {9-10}=very_hard; eval subset keeps full-benchmark stratification
tier_strategies.olympiad: healthy text-only pool only; 5 type buckets × 4 subject-specific quartile difficulty tiers, sampling 1 train sample and 5 eval-subset samples per cell

naturalplan_split.note: Index-only combined split; train is 10 per subtask and heldout is the 900-task clean-first balanced main set; original NaturalPlan dataset JSON files are not modified.

naturalplan.description: Combined NaturalPlan split with index-only mappings; original dataset JSON files are unchanged.
naturalplan.train_ordering: 10 difficulty-interleaved train keys per subtask; for each position in the per-subtask curriculum prefix, emit trip/calendar/meeting to keep early batches subtask-balanced.
naturalplan.eval_subset_policy: 100 quality-clean non-train samples per subtask, sampled from the main heldout and stratified by each subtask's difficulty tiers.
naturalplan.heldout_policy: Main heldout is a 900-task balanced set: first draw up to 300 quality-clean non-train samples per subtask, then fill any clean shortfall from quality-flagged non-train samples; keys are stratified by difficulty tiers and interleaved by tier/subtask.
naturalplan.clean_full_policy: All quality-clean non-train samples are retained only as clean_full_keys for audit/optional analysis; heldout_clean_keys is sampled from this pool before any dirty fallback is used.
naturalplan.quality_filter: Excludes unsolvable, non_unique, and wrong_answer samples from clean train and clean-first eval pools; heldout uses explicit dirty fallback only if clean pools cannot reach 300 per subtask.
